{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: build all

on:
  # all branches:
  [ push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch ]
  # trunk only:
  #push:
  #  branches: [ "trunk" ]
  #pull_request:
  #  branches: [ "trunk" ]

jobs:
  compile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04

    steps:

    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@master
      # allow 'git describe' to work, by fetching tags and history
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
        fetch-tags: true

    - name: Stop committing version.h
      # reject commit if version.h was changed
      run: grep 1969-07-20 ui/anduril/version.h

    - name: Cache APT packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: /var/cache/apt/archives
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-apt-avr-toolchain-v1

    - name: Requirements
      run: |
        sudo apt-get -qqy update
        sudo apt-get -qqy install avr-libc binutils-avr gcc-avr unzip wget

    - name: Cache Atmel DFPs
      id: cache-dfp
      uses: actions/cache@v3
      env:
        cache-name: cache-dfp-files
      with:
        path: arch/dfp
        # new cache whenever the dfp-install script changes
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ env.cache-name }}-${{ hashFiles('bin/dfp-install.sh') }}

    - name: Install Atmel DFPs
      if: steps.cache-dfp.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      run: |
        ./make dfp

    - name: Compile All
      run: |
        ./make
        echo "ARTIFACT_NAME=${GITHUB_WORKFLOW}-$(git rev-parse --short ${GITHUB_SHA})-${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"

    - name: Store Artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: ${{ env.ARTIFACT_NAME }}
        if-no-files-found: error
        path: |
          hex/*.hex
",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly downloads and installs system dependencies (avr-libc, binutils-avr, gcc-avr, unzip, wget) via apt on every run without caching them, while already caching the Atmel DFPs. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-download-caching pattern is supported by measured CI evidence showing 6-20% runtime reduction when dependency downloads are cached before installation. Adding an actions/cache step for the apt archives before the Requirements step preserves all build and test steps and coverage, only avoiding repeated network downloads of unchanged packages.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200"]
}
